On April 3, 2024, the reporting person was granted an award of performance-based restricted stock units (the "2024 PSUs"), which are eligible to be earned in the form of restricted stock units based on the volume-weighted average closing price per share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock during the final 20 consecutive trading days of each fiscal quarter beginning with the fourth fiscal quarter of 2024 and ending with, and including, the fourth fiscal quarter of 2028. Any unearned portion of the PSUs will expire on January 1, 2029. On October 22, 2026, the Issuer determined that the performance conditions were met at the maximum level with respect to the 2024 PSUs, resulting in these securities being earned, with 33.33% of such securities vesting on such date of determination and the remainder vesting in equal installments every three months thereafter, subject to the reporting person's continued service with the Issuer through each applicable vesting date. || On each of February 23, 2022 and April 21, 2023, the reporting person was granted an award of performance-based restricted stock units (respectively, the "2022 PSUs" and the "2023 PSUs" and, collectively with the 2024 PSUs, the "PSUs"), which are eligible to be earned in the form of restricted stock units based on the volume-weighted average closing price per share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock during the final 20 consecutive trading days of each fiscal quarter. On October 22, 2026, the Issuer determined that the performance conditions exceeded the prior earned level with respect to the 2022 PSUs and 2023 PSUs, resulting in these securities being earned, which securities vest three equal annual installments beginning on such date of determination. || Share balance includes stock purchased under an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) not previously reported.
Withholding of shares in satisfaction of taxes due upon the vesting of PSUs under the Issuer's Incentive Award Plan.
Pursuant to the PSU award agreements and the Issuer's Incentive Award Plan, the Issuer elected to cash settle the earned PSUs that vest on October 22, 2026.

On April 17, 2023, the holder was granted 100,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs"), as previously reported on a Form 4 filed on April 19, 2023, of which 6,250 of these RSUs vested on October 17,
2026. The sale reported on this Form 4 represents shares sold by the Reporting Person to cover tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting and settlement of these RSUs. The sale is
mandated by the Issuer's election to require the satisfaction of tax withholding obligations to be funded by a "sell to cover" transaction and does not represent a discretionary transaction by the Reporting Person. || The price reported is a weighted average price. to the Issuer, any security holder of the Issuer, or the staff of the Securities and Exchange Commission, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price within the
range set forth in this footnote to this Form 4.
